# Reconnecting Intelligence With The Soul — Book Edition 0.1

> A living HTML book by G. K. M. Jarif Ur Rahim on responsible AI, human agency, cognitive system design, the future of work, and the philosophy of intelligence.

## Editorial note
This is a working edition. Distinguish documented evidence, personal reflection, and conceptual proposal when citing or summarizing it. Check the landing page for the latest edition statement.
